full_prompt_en: A square, softly painterly portrait image shows a young woman sitting against a dark, mottled wall and looking toward light outside the left edge. The background is almost entirely deep olive-brown shadow, broken only by faint plaster-like texture and a cluster of tall, thin leaves rising behind her on the right. She sits slightly left of center, shown from the waist upward, with her torso facing forward and her head turned into a clear left-facing profile. Warm auburn hair is gathered loosely, with strands slipping over her shoulder and around the neck. Her expression is quiet and intent, the eyes directed beyond the frame rather than toward the viewer. An open-collared white blouse hangs in soft, slightly rumpled folds; the sleeves are pushed up at the forearms, revealing hands resting low together in her lap. Narrow brown straps cross the shoulders and connect the light shirt to a darker lower garment. The left cheek, forehead, nose, and collar catch a narrow band of gentle light, while the far side of the face and torso sink into brown-black shade. The blouse is the broadest light shape in the lower half, but its fabric remains subdued and textured instead of brilliant white. The plant leaves at the right are only partly resolved, their slender arcs adding a quiet vertical counterweight to the seated figure. Light enters from the upper left, softly modeling skin, hair, and cloth and leaving the background with minimal reflected illumination. Fine grain and restrained brush-like tonal transitions give the image a tactile, old-master stillness. The overall composition balances a luminous profile and pale fabric against broad dark space, creating a contemplative and intimate mood.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、带柔和绘画感的肖像图像呈现一位年轻女子坐在深暗斑驳的墙前，望向画面左缘之外的亮处。背景几乎全是深橄榄棕色阴影，只被淡淡灰泥般纹理和右后方升起的一簇细长叶片打断。她略坐在中央偏左，以腰部以上入镜，躯干朝前，头转成清楚的左向侧影。暖赤褐色头发松松束起，几缕发丝滑过肩膀和颈边。她神情安静而专注，目光投向画外，而非观者。敞领白衬衣以柔软略皱的衣褶垂下，袖口推到前臂，露出低低合放在腿上的双手。细棕色肩带越过肩部，将浅色衬衣与下方深色衣物连起来。左侧面颊、额头、鼻梁与衣领接住一道柔和的窄光，脸和身体远侧沉入棕黑阴影。衬衣是下半部最宽的浅色形块，但布料仍克制而有纹理，并非耀眼纯白。右侧叶片只局部可辨，其细长弧线为坐着的人物添加安静的竖向配重。光从左上方进入，柔和塑造肌肤、头发和布料，背景几乎没有反射照明。细颗粒与克制的笔刷般调性过渡让图像具有可触的古典静止感。整体构图以发亮侧脸与浅色织物平衡宽阔暗处，形成沉思而亲密的情绪。
style_prompt_en: The image uses restrained chiaroscuro, allowing a small side-lit focal region to emerge from broad olive-brown and near-black shadow. Light fabrics or pale planes are modeled through soft gray folds instead of flat white, while warm skinlike tones remain quiet and natural. Edges are clearest at the illuminated profile and dissolve quickly toward the background. Subtle grain and mottled surface texture keep the dark areas tactile rather than empty. A few thin vertical curves offset the compact focal mass without competing with it. The overall treatment is intimate, painterly, and contemplative, with light shaping volume more than color contrast.
style_prompt_zh: 图像采用克制的明暗法，让一小片侧面受光的焦点区域从宽阔橄榄棕与近黑阴影中显现。浅色织物或平面通过柔灰褶皱塑形，而非平铺白色；暖肤色也保持安静自然。边缘在受光侧影处最清楚，向背景迅速消融。细颗粒和斑驳表面肌理使暗区可触，而非空白。少数纤细竖向弧线偏移紧凑焦点团块，却不与之争夺注意。整体处理亲密、具绘画感而沉思，更多由光而非色彩反差塑造体积。
theme_en: A young woman sitting in shadow and looking toward side light
theme_zh: 一位年轻女子坐在阴影中，望向侧面来光
name: Subdued tones
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
